fee_type: Street impact fee: ADU or small redevelopment on a site with an existing structure (under 10 PM-peak-hour trips)
payment_timing: at permit
source_section: Are Accessory Dwelling Units, or ADUs, subject to paying a SIF?
source_quote: If the addition of an Accessory Dwelling Unit , or ADU, occurs on a site where there is an existing structure (land use) generating trips, then no fee will be required, as an ADU does not generate at least 10 trips during the PM Peak Hour.
notes: Austin; Street Impact Fee Program (Ords. 20201210-061 and -062, adopted 2020-12-10; collection began 2022-06-21; collected when the building permit is issued). Redevelopment pays only if it generates at least 10 PM-peak-hour trips, so an ADU or a small 2-4 unit project replacing a house on a previously developed lot pays $0 (coded as the infill prototype). Sites where development has never occurred pay regardless of trips (rates by service area in the fee collection rates document, not read; not coded).
